issues.display_title: Issue #555: Refactor AddPostGothru Endpoint for Crash Prevention and Storage Cleanup
issues.main_description_html:
Task: Refactor AddPostGothru Endpoint for Crash Prevention and Storage Cleanup

  • Area: Posts / GoThru Integration / Stability / Storage
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru_test.go
  • Date: 2026-10-20

1. Problem

The endpoint POST /add-gothru implemented in src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru.go contained critical server termination patterns and disk leak risks:

  1. Fatal Server Termination (log.Fatalln):
    • Three separate calls to log.Fatalln were used during MinIO client initialization (InitMinioClient), bucket creation, and file upload (CreateBucketAndUploadFile).
    • If MinIO or the S3 backend was momentarily unreachable, the calls invoked os.Exit(1), killing the entire API server process and dropping all active user connections.
  2. Disk Leakage on Failure:
    • In case of upload failures or invalid imgproxy signing keys/salts, temporary panorama files saved under UPLOAD_DIR/<encrypt>/ were not removed, leading to lingering unreferenced files on disk.

2. Scope

  1. Refactor Error Handling in src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru.go:

    • Replace all log.Fatalln invocations with non-fatal log.Printf logging.
    • Return standardized HTTP error responses via Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 500, fiber.ErrInternalServerError.Message, ...) matching the conventions in AddPost.go.
    • Ensure os.Remove(imgPanorama) is executed upon storage errors and imgproxy key/salt validation failures to eliminate temporary file leaks.

  2. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Create src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru_test.go verifying:
      • Rejection of invalid/empty user data context (HTTP 401 Unauthorized).
      • Proper validation on missing input files.

3. Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Route /add-gothru, request parameters (category_id, panorama, description), database inserts, and response payloads remain identical.
    • Successful GoThru post uploads proceed with identical image transformations, signing, and metadata insertions.
    • Failures in MinIO/S3 now return clean HTTP 500 responses rather than crashing the API process.

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • Zero occurrences of log.Fatal / log.Fatalln in src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostGothru.go.
  • Temporary files are cleanly cleaned up on error paths.
  • Unit tests pass cleanly with go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Posts/....
  • go build ./cmd/... succeeds without errors.

issues.display_title: Issue #556: Standardize HTTP Client Timeouts and Connection Pooling
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Standardize HTTP Client Timeouts and Connection Pooling

  • Date: 2026-10-20
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS

1. Summary

Standardized all outgoing HTTP requests across panorra-api-go-new to use the shared Functions.HTTPClient:

  1. Standardized Timeout & Pooling:

    • Replaced all 10 occurrences of http.DefaultClient with Functions.HTTPClient (10s timeout, connection pooling).
    • Replaced all 4 occurrences of ad-hoc &http.Client{} instances with Functions.HTTPClient.
    • Prevented nil pointer panics on failed http.NewRequest calls in background cronjobs by ensuring requests exit or continue early before Do().

  2. Files Refactored:

    • src/Action/V1/Centrifugo/PublishChannel.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedTourmkr.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedVillume.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedYoutube.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckInvalidTokenGoogle.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteUser.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/MessageNewPosts.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationTourmkr.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationVillume.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationYoutube.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaDbx.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/BroadcastFunctions/BroadcastFunctions.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/cloud_storage.go

2. Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./src/...
# PASS (0 warnings / 0 errors)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test ./src/Action/... ./src/Utils/... ./src/Worker/...
# PASS: 100% test suites pass cleanly

  • Build Check:

    go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: Networking / Stability / Cronjobs / Core Utils
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Action/V1/Centrifugo/PublishChannel.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedTourmkr.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedVillume.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckEmbedYoutube.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/CheckInvalidTokenGoogle.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/DeleteUser.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/MessageNewPosts.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationTourmkr.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationVillume.go
    • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/NotificationYoutube.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/UploadPanoramaDbx.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/BroadcastFunctions/BroadcastFunctions.go
    • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/cloud_storage.go
  • Date: 2026-10-20

1. Problem

Multiple modules across panorra-api-go-new were using http.DefaultClient or instantiating ad-hoc &http.Client{} instances without timeouts:

  1. Goroutine and Socket Leakage:
    • http.DefaultClient has zero timeout by design. If external providers (YouTube oEmbed, Tourmkr, Villume, Google OAuth, Dropbox API, Centrifugo) hang or drop packets, outgoing HTTP requests block indefinitely.
    • Under traffic or network partitions, blocked requests accumulate leaking goroutines and exhausting file descriptors.
  2. Missing Connection Pooling in Loops:
    • Handlers such as MessageNewPosts.go instantiated a fresh &http.Client{} inside loops on every iteration, bypassing TCP connection reuse and causing TCP socket churn.

2. Scope

  1. Adopt Shared Functions.HTTPClient:

    • Migrate all outbound HTTP calls to use Functions.HTTPClient (configured with strict 10-second timeout and connection pooling).
    • Guard against nil resp or failed requests before closing response bodies (defer resp.Body.Close()).
    • Clean up loop allocations.

  2. Affected Modules:

    • Cronjob embed checkers: CheckEmbedTourmkr.go, CheckEmbedVillume.go, CheckEmbedYoutube.go.
    • Cronjob notification dispatchers: NotificationTourmkr.go, NotificationVillume.go, NotificationYoutube.go.
    • Cronjob maintenance tasks: DeleteUser.go, CheckInvalidTokenGoogle.go, MessageNewPosts.go.
    • Post embed and cloud storage workflows: AddPostCompleteEmbed.go, UploadPanoramaDbx.go, cloud_storage.go.
    • Centrifugo & broadcast delivery: PublishChannel.go, BroadcastFunctions.go.

3. Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Zero change to HTTP method types, headers, request URLs, and response handling.
    • Outgoing HTTP calls now fail fast after 10 seconds rather than hanging indefinitely.

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • Zero occurrences of http.DefaultClient or unconfigured &http.Client{} across the codebase.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./...).
  • Service builds cleanly (go build ./cmd/...).
